question.text: What will the Tokyo (Ku-area) core CPI year-on-year inflation rate be for November 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the year-on-year percentage change in the "total index excluding fresh food" (生鮮食品を除く総合) for the Ku-area of Tokyo (東京都区部) for survey month November 2026, as published by the Statistics Bureau of Japan (Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications) in its mid-month preliminary release (中旬速報値), scheduled for 08:30 JST on Friday 27 November 2026 (23:30 UTC on 26 November 2026). The resolving figure is the year-on-year change reported for 生鮮食品を除く総合 in Table 1 of that release, available at https://www.stat.go.jp/data/cpi/sokuhou/tsuki/index-t.html (press-release PDF: https://www.stat.go.jp/data/cpi/sokuhou/tsuki/pdf/kubu.pdf); a published figure of 2.6% would resolve as 2.6. If those pages are unreachable, the same official figure reported by [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) may be used, and if the release is merely delayed, resolution waits for publication. If the Statistics Bureau cancels the November 2026 mid-month preliminary Tokyo CPI release, the question is annulled.
question.fine_print: The resolving series is the total index excluding fresh food only (生鮮食品を除く総合); the all-items index (総合) and the index excluding fresh food and energy (生鮮食品及びエネルギーを除く総合) are not used. The figure as first published in the November 2026 mid-month preliminary release governs; any later revision of the series does not change the resolution.

research:
I found no economist forecast yet for the November 2026 Tokyo core CPI, and none of the supplied prediction markets measures this series. The pieces that matter most are the energy base effect and the trend in food prices.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-10-30: The Statistics Bureau's Tokyo preliminary page (index-t.html) still shows the October 2026 release as the latest, published 30 Oct. Its links are kubu.pdf and e-Stat tables. I could not read the PDF with my tools. [stat.go.jp](https://www.stat.go.jp/data/cpi/sokuhou/tsuki/index-t.html)
- 2026-10-30: October figures: core (ex-fresh food) +2.6% year-on-year (Sep +2.7%), all-items +2.8%, ex-fresh food and energy +2.6% (Sep +2.9%). Core rose +0.3% month-on-month seasonally adjusted (Sep +0.9%). The result matched the Reuters median of +2.6%. [OANDA](https://www.oanda.jp/lab-education/market_news/tokyocpi-jobs-oct-2026-review/), [Reuters/Infoseek](https://news.infoseek.co.jp/article/30reutersJAPAN_KCN3WA027/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The November figure comes out 2026-11-27 at 08:30 JST, and I found no published consensus for it.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-16: The dollar is near 159.6-159.9 yen, and markets fear Japan will intervene to support the yen. Japan's Q3 GDP fell 0.1%. [Zaikei](https://www.zaikei.co.jp/article/20261116/877757.html)
- 2026-11-15: Japanese wholesale inflation was 7.1% year-on-year in October (forecast 6.5%), and import prices rose 24.8%. Bets on a Bank of Japan hike to 1.5% in December are rising. These are leading cost pressures. [FXEmpire](https://www.fxempire.com/forecasts/article/japan-interest-rate-forecast-boj-hike-bets-rise-as-usd-jpy-tests-160-1644705)
- 2026-10-30: Details of the October Tokyo print:
  - Energy +2.2%: electricity +1.7% and city gas +4.9%, both turning positive.
  - Water charges fell from +65.6% to 0%.
  - Rice -31.3%, the biggest fall since 1971.
  - Food ex-fresh +3.0%.
  - UBS's Kurihara called the data a "weak impression", with food weaker than expected. [Reuters/Infoseek](https://news.infoseek.co.jp/article/30reutersJAPAN_KCN3WA027/)
- 2026-10-30: Dai-ichi Life (DLRI) put core excluding special factors at +3.2% (Sep +3.0%). Nikkei CPINow was +3.6% on 27 Oct, against +2.9% during the CPI survey period. DLRI says oil pass-through is "likely" to push inflation higher. [DLRI](https://www.dlri.co.jp/report/macro/672247.html)
- 2026-10-30: OANDA expects energy to push the index up "from November", because the electricity and gas subsidies have ended. It says the drag from childcare fees continues until March 2027. [OANDA](https://www.oanda.jp/lab-education/market_news/tokyocpi-jobs-oct-2026-review/)
- Subsidy timing:
  - 2026 summer: July and September usage got 3.5 yen/kWh, August 4.5 yen/kWh. City gas got 14/18/14 yen per cubic metre. October usage gets nothing. [Selectra](https://selectra.jp/energy/news/electricity-subsidy-end-october-2026)
  - 2025: the subsidy also ended with October-month CPI, which lifted electricity inflation in November 2025. So both years have no subsidy in November. The higher 2026 discount drops out, and the base had already risen in November 2025. [DLRI via search](https://www.dlri.co.jp/report/macro/546529.html)

## 4. Base rates
- Recent core year-on-year values: Aug 2026 +1.8%, Sep +2.7%, Oct +2.6%. [DLRI](https://www.dlri.co.jp/files/macro/666224.pdf)
- Base period: Oct 2025 +2.8%, Nov 2025 +2.8% (consensus then +2.7%), Dec 2025 about +2.3%. In November 2025, higher electricity and gas inflation offset slowing food. [Monex](https://media.monex.co.jp/articles/-/28300)
- Seasonal pattern, October to November change in core year-on-year. These are from my own memory of past releases; I did not re-verify them in this session:
  - 2021: 0.1 → 0.3 (+0.2)
  - 2022: 3.4 → 3.6 (+0.2)
  - 2023: 2.7 → 2.3 (-0.4, travel subsidy and energy effects)
  - 2024: 1.8 → 2.2 (+0.4, energy subsidy base effect)
  - 2025: 2.8 → 2.8 (0)
- Typical month-to-month moves are 0.1-0.4pp, larger when a subsidy starts or stops. The 2026 summer subsidy was bigger than 2025's, which suggests its removal in November adds more to the year-on-year rate than usual.

## 5. Other forecasts
- **Kalshi markets supplied: they do not match.** The "Core CPI YoY in November" ladder (above 2.8%: 0.71, above 2.9%: 0.41; exact 2.9%/3.0%: 0.28 each) and the headline CPI ladder (around 3.7-3.8%) match US BLS CPI levels, not Tokyo. The month-on-month market is also US. Do not use them.
- **Polymarket "Japan Core CPI YoY in 2026" (≤1.9%: 0.66): it does not match.** It covers a calendar-year national figure, not the November Tokyo print.
- I found no economist consensus for November Tokyo core yet. The Reuters and QUICK polls usually appear about a week before release.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- About 2026-11-20 (19 Nov ET): national October CPI. It will be a check on how fast energy and food costs are passing through. [Kalshi listing referenced above]
- Late November: Reuters and QUICK consensus for Tokyo November core.
- Ongoing: risk of yen intervention near 160 per dollar, and continued pass-through of oil and import prices. The November survey period (mid-month) is mostly already fixed by now.
- Weather has no material relevance, since fresh food is excluded.

I found no published forecast or prediction market for Tokyo core CPI in November 2026 yet. Energy is the clearest upward push, while rice and food are pulling the rate down.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-16: The Statistics Bureau's Tokyo page (index-t.html) still shows the October 2026 release, published 2026-10-30, as its latest. The November release is due 2026-11-27 at 08:30 JST. [stat.go.jp](https://www.stat.go.jp/data/cpi/sokuhou/tsuki/index-t.html)
- 2026-10-30: October figures. The resolving series (all items excluding fresh food) rose 2.6% year on year, down from 2.7% in September. All items rose 2.8% and the index excluding fresh food and energy rose 2.6%. On a seasonally adjusted month-on-month basis, the resolving series rose 0.3% (September: 0.9%). [OANDA](https://www.oanda.jp/lab-education/market_news/tokyocpi-jobs-oct-2026-review/), [Nikkei](https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXZQOUA297XQ0Z21C26A0000000/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question. The November survey is under way and no figure has been published.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-16: Japan's Q3 GDP fell 0.1%. The dollar is near 160 yen, and a weak yen raises import costs. [Zaikei](https://www.zaikei.co.jp/article/20261116/877757.html)
- 2026-11-15: Japan's October wholesale inflation was 7.1% (forecast 6.5%) and import prices were up 24.8% year on year. Markets are pricing a Bank of Japan hike to 1.5% in December. [FXEmpire](https://www.fxempire.com/forecasts/article/japan-interest-rate-forecast-boj-hike-bets-rise-as-usd-jpy-tests-160-1644705)
- 2026-11-13: The average supermarket price for 5 kg of rice was 2,747 yen in the week of Nov 2-8, down 69 yen and resuming its decline. Cheaper 2026-crop rice is spreading. [NHK](https://news.web.nhk/newsweb/na/nd-20261113de75624)
- 2026-11-11: The national average for regular gasoline was 169.9 yen per litre on Nov 9, falling for a third straight week. A year earlier it was about 173.5 yen, so it is about 2% lower year on year. Fuel subsidies shrink from 12-03, after the November survey. [Fukui Shimbun](https://www.fukuishimbun.co.jp/articles/-/2744202)
- 2026-10-30, energy and subsidies:
  - Energy swung from -1.9% to +2.2% year on year: electricity +1.7%, city gas +4.9%, gasoline -2.3%.
  - Electricity subsidies lowered all-items CPI by about 0.35pp. October's subsidy was 3.5 yen/kWh, against 2.0 yen a year earlier.
  - OANDA says the subsidies run only through the October data, so "from November, energy should push the y/y rate up."
  - [OANDA](https://www.oanda.jp/lab-education/market_news/tokyocpi-jobs-oct-2026-review/)
- 2026-10-30, other items:
  - Rice fell 31.3% year on year.
  - The childcare-fee drag stays at -0.21pp until the March 2027 data.
  - Water charges contributed 0.00pp, after 0.24pp in September.
  - [OANDA](https://www.oanda.jp/lab-education/market_news/tokyocpi-jobs-oct-2026-review/)
- 2026-10: Dai-ichi Life's research institute says passing on higher crude oil prices will likely push inflation higher. Its trimmed-mean measure rose from 2.3% to 2.4%. [DLRI](https://www.dlri.co.jp/report/macro/672247.html)

## 4. Base rates and seasonality
- **What the November 2025 base contains.** The November 2025 core rate held at 2.8%, unchanged from October, and above QUICK's 2.7% consensus. In that month:
  - Energy rose 2.6% (electricity +4.5%) because 2025 subsidies ended with the October index.
  - Food excluding fresh food rose 6.5%, rice 37.9% and hotels 9.2%.
  - So the base already includes one subsidy step-up, of about 2.0 yen/kWh. November 2026 removes a larger one (3.5 yen), a net upward energy effect worth roughly 1.5 yen/kWh. That is my own inference.
  - [Nikkei](https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXZQOUA265IJ0W5A121C2000000/)
- **Rice.** The November 2025 base was high, about 4,000+ yen per 5 kg (my approximation). Current prices around 2,750 yen point to rice deflation of about -35% or deeper, against -31.3% in October.
- **October-to-November moves in past years:**

| Year | October | November | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2025 | 2.8 | 2.8 | 0.0 |
| 2024 | 1.8 | 2.2 | +0.4 |
| 2023 | 2.7 | 2.3 | -0.4 |

  - In 2024 the rise came from shrinking subsidies; in 2023, from subsidy effects.
  - Changes in 2021 and 2022 were about +0.2 each (from memory, not checked).
  - Typical October-to-November moves are ±0.0 to 0.4pp, and they are driven by energy-subsidy timing.
  - [Nikkei 2024](https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXZQOUA284I50Y4A121C2000000/), [Nikkei 2023](https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXZQOUA04BVP0U3A201C2000000/)

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no consensus forecast (QUICK or Bloomberg) for November 2026 yet. They usually appear about a week before the release.
- **The Kalshi markets you were given do not match this question.**
  - "Core CPI YoY in November" (most likely 2.9-3.0%) and the headline "CPI YoY" market (3.7-3.8%) fit US CPI levels. US headline was 3.7% in September.
  - Their November contract dates also look like US data.
  - Do not use them for Tokyo.
- Polymarket's "Japan Core CPI YoY in 2026" covers the national full-year figure (≤1.9% at 66%), so it is not comparable either.
- The only related figure is Takumori's estimate of about 2.6% for national October core CPI. [note](https://note.com/akiyoshitakumori/n/nccedb77981b4)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- About 2026-11-19 to 20: national October CPI, which will confirm the energy and food split.
- Weekly rice prices from the farm ministry (about 11-20) and gasoline surveys (11-18 and 11-25). The Tokyo price survey covers roughly the middle of the month.
- Bank of Japan rhetoric and a weak yen pushing up import costs could affect goods prices but are unlikely to show in November's index.
- About 11-20 to 25: market consensus forecasts are published.
- Weather matters only through fresh food, which the resolving series excludes.

Sources: [stat.go.jp](https://www.stat.go.jp/data/cpi/sokuhou/tsuki/index-t.html), [OANDA](https://www.oanda.jp/lab-education/market_news/tokyocpi-jobs-oct-2026-review/), [Nikkei Oct 2026](https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXZQOUA297XQ0Z21C26A0000000/), [Nikkei Nov 2025](https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXZQOUA265IJ0W5A121C2000000/), [DLRI](https://www.dlri.co.jp/report/macro/672247.html), [NHK](https://news.web.nhk/newsweb/na/nd-20261113de75624), [Fukui Shimbun](https://www.fukuishimbun.co.jp/articles/-/2744202), [FXEmpire](https://www.fxempire.com/forecasts/article/japan-interest-rate-forecast-boj-hike-bets-rise-as-usd-jpy-tests-160-1644705), [Zaikei](https://www.zaikei.co.jp/article/20261116/877757.html), [Nikkei 2024](https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXZQOUA284I50Y4A121C2000000/), [Nikkei 2023](https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXZQOUA04BVP0U3A201C2000000/), [Takumori note](https://note.com/akiyoshitakumori/n/nccedb77981b4)
